komazawa-olympic-park.name: Komazawa Olympic Park
komazawa-olympic-park.address: 1-1 Komazawa Koen, Setagaya-ku, Tokyo (location of the Komazawa Olympic Park management office)
komazawa-olympic-park.access: 15 minutes on foot from Komazawa-Daigaku Station (Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line). Tokyu Bus from Shibuya (JR Yamanote Line) to “Komazawa Koen Higashiguchi”, or from Ebisu to “Komazawa Koen”
komazawa-olympic-park.summary: A metropolitan park. The Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association announces the flea market dates in the Central Plaza for each fiscal year. The organizer differs from one event to the next.
komazawa-olympic-park.rules: Changes at the organizer’s discretion or cancellation in bad weather are possible. Ask each organizing group for event details and stall applications.

yoyogi-park.name: Yoyogi Park
yoyogi-park.address: Yoyogi Kamizono-cho, Shibuya-ku (Area A); 1-chome and 2-chome Jinnan (Area B)
yoyogi-park.access: 3 minutes on foot from Harajuku (JR Yamanote Line) / 3 minutes on foot from Yoyogi-koen (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line) / 3 minutes on foot from Meiji-jingumae <Harajuku> (Chiyoda and Fukutoshin Lines) / 6 minutes on foot from Yoyogi-Hachiman (Odakyu Line)
yoyogi-park.summary: A metropolitan park. Its monthly event information sometimes lists flea markets in the Event Plaza (on 8/22 and 8/23 in 2026). No regular schedule has been confirmed from official sources.
yoyogi-park.rules: The Jinnan 1-chome area, which has the outdoor urban sports park and other facilities, is not managed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association (per the official site).

sunshine-city.name: Sunshine City
sunshine-city.access: About 8 minutes on foot from Exit 35 of Ikebukuro Station (JR, Tokyo Metro, Seibu and Tobu lines); about 3 minutes on foot through the underground passage from Exits 6 and 7 of Higashi-Ikebukuro Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line) (both to the Sunshine City entrance)
sunshine-city.summary: A commercial complex in Ikebukuro. The “Sunshine City Big Flea Market” (organizer: Otakara Net) is held in Sunshine Plaza.
sunshine-city.rules: The 11/3/2026 event is cancelled in case of rain (per the official event page).

hikarigaoka-park.name: Hikarigaoka Park
hikarigaoka-park.address: 4-1-1 Hikarigaoka, Nerima-ku, Tokyo (the official site says this is the address of the whole park)
hikarigaoka-park.access: About 8 minutes on foot from Hikarigaoka Station (Toei Oedo Line) to Keyaki Plaza
hikarigaoka-park.summary: A metropolitan park. Its monthly event notices list flea markets planned in Keyaki Plaza (gymnasium side).
hikarigaoka-park.rules: Start and end times may vary. The schedule may change or be cancelled in rain etc. Ask each organizing group for event details and stall applications.

oi-racecourse.name: Oi Racecourse
oi-racecourse.summary: The venue of the “Tokyo City Flea Market” run by Tokyo Recycle. Its schedule page lists 21 days from 10/24 to 12/27 in 2026.
oi-racecourse.rules: From the organizer, Tokyo Recycle (applies to its events in general): do not push price negotiation too far. Pickpocketing and bag theft are reported as frequent at the venue, so keep valuables safe. Buying counterfeit brand goods is a crime. Except for personal commemorative photos, photography needs the organizer’s prior permission. Smoking is allowed only in designated smoking areas.

koganei-park.name: Koganei Park
koganei-park.address: 3-chome Sakuracho, 1-chome and 2-chome Sekinomachi (Koganei City); 3-chome Hanakoganei-minamicho (Kodaira City); 6-chome Mukaidaicho (Nishitokyo City); 3-chome Sakuratsutsumi (Musashino City)
koganei-park.access: Seibu Bus from Musashi-Koganei Station (JR Chuo Line) to “Koganei Koen Nishiguchi”. CoCo Bus from Higashi-Koganei Station (JR Chuo Line) to “Koganei Koen Iriguchi”. Seibu Bus from Hanakoganei Station (Seibu Shinjuku Line) to “Koganei Koen Nishiguchi”
koganei-park.summary: A metropolitan park. Its location spans Koganei, Kodaira, Nishitokyo and Musashino cities.

tokyo-international-forum.name: Tokyo International Forum
tokyo-international-forum.access: In front of JR Yurakucho Station
tokyo-international-forum.summary: A facility with halls and conference rooms.

showa-kinen-park.name: Showa Kinen Park (Showa Memorial Park)
showa-kinen-park.access: Akebono Gate (Midori Culture Zone): about 10 min from the north exit of Tachikawa Station (Chuo Line) / about 8 min from the Koen exit of Tachikawa-Kita Station
showa-kinen-park.summary: A national park. The Midori Culture Zone is the free area, and the paid area has 5 gates.

takahata-fudoson.name: Takahata-Fudoson Kongoji
takahata-fudoson.access: 5 min walk from Takahata-Fudo Station (Keio Line / Tama Monorail)
takahata-fudoson.summary: Takahata-Fudoson Kongoji, a temple in Takahata, Hino City.

nishiarai-daishi.name: Nishiarai Daishi Temple
nishiarai-daishi.access: 4 min walk from Daishimae Station (Tobu Daishi Line) / about 16 min walk from Nishiarai-Daishi-Nishi Station (Nippori-Toneri Liner)
nishiarai-daishi.summary: A temple of the Buzan school of Shingon Buddhism in Nishiarai, Adachi City. The official site says it is about a 5 min walk from the parking lot to the main hall.

tomioka-hachimangu.name: Tomioka Hachimangu Shrine
tomioka-hachimangu.access: 5 min. from Monzen-Nakacho Station (Tozai Line, Toei Oedo Line) (no parking)

machida-tenmangu.name: Machida Tenmangu Shrine
machida-tenmangu.access: 8 min. on foot from Machida Station (Odakyu Line) / 5 min. from Machida Station (JR Yokohama Line)

setagaya-park.name: Setagaya Ward Park (Setagaya Park)
setagaya-park.access: 18 min walk from Ikejiri-Ohashi Station (Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line) / 18 min walk from Sangenjaya Station (Tokyu Setagaya Line / Den-en-toshi Line)
setagaya-park.summary: A park presented by Setagaya City. It is the largest park in the Setagaya area, with a fountain plaza, sports facilities and a play park.

kiba-park.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Kiba Park
kiba-park.address: Kiba 4-5-chome, Hirano 4-chome, Miyoshi 4-chome and Toyo 6-chome, Koto-ku, Tokyo
kiba-park.access: 10 min walk from Kiba Station (T13, Tokyo Metro Tozai Line) / 15 min walk from Kiyosumi-Shirakawa Station (Z11, E14, Hanzomon Line / Oedo Line) / 15 min walk from Kikukawa Station (S12, Toei Shinjuku Line)
kiba-park.summary: A park presented by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association. Admission is free (some facilities charge a fee).

ajinomoto-stadium.name: Ajinomoto Stadium
ajinomoto-stadium.access: 5 min walk from Tobitakyu Station (Keio Line), 20 min walk from Tama Station (Seibu Tamagawa Line)
ajinomoto-stadium.summary: A stadium in Chofu City. The parking lot cannot be used during events such as J.League matches and large concerts.

fussa-baseside-street.name: Fussa Baseside Street (Friendship Park)
fussa-baseside-street.summary: Friendship Park, a park in Fussa City. Opened on 4/1 of Heisei 8 (1996); area 1463.81 square meters.

kinshi-park.name: Kinshi Park
kinshi-park.access: Kinshicho Station (JR Sobu Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line)
kinshi-park.summary: A park in Sumida City. Higashin Arena (Sumida City General Gymnasium), a baseball field and tennis courts are located in the park.

naka-ikebukuro-park.name: Naka-Ikebukuro Park
naka-ikebukuro-park.access: Ikebukuro Station (JR, Tokyo Metro, Tobu Tojo Line, Seibu Ikebukuro Line)
naka-ikebukuro-park.summary: A park in Toshima City, managed by the Hareza Ikebukuro Area Management association as the designated manager.

hanakawado-park.name: Hanakawado Park
hanakawado-park.address: 1-14-15 Hanakawado and other lots, Taito-ku, Tokyo

arakawa-park.name: Arakawa Park
arakawa-park.access: 4 min walk from the Arakawa 2-chome or Arakawa Kuyakusho-mae stop (Toden Arakawa Line)
arakawa-park.summary: A park in Arakawa City, also called the Ward Office Park, with a fountain at its center.

ukima-park.name: Ukima Park
ukima-park.address: 2 Ukima, Kita-ku and 2 Funado, Itabashi-ku, Tokyo
ukima-park.access: 1 min walk from Ukima-Funado Station (JR Saikyo Line)
ukima-park.summary: A Tokyo metropolitan park spanning Kita and Itabashi wards (per the Kita City guide).

akatsuka-park.name: Akatsuka Park
akatsuka-park.address: Takashimadaira 3-chome, Tokumaru 7-8-chome, Yotsuba 2-chome, Daimon, Akatsuka 4, 5 and 8-chome, Itabashi-ku, Tokyo
akatsuka-park.access: 8 min walk from Takashimadaira Station (I25, Toei Mita Line) / 1 min walk from the Akatsuka-koen bus stop (Kokusai Kogyo bus from Narimasu Station, bound for Takashimadaira Depot)
akatsuka-park.summary: A park presented by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association. Admission is free (some facilities charge a fee).

oshima-komatsugawa-park.name: Oshima Komatsugawa Park
oshima-komatsugawa-park.access: 3 min walk from Higashi-Ojima Station (Toei Shinjuku Line)
oshima-komatsugawa-park.summary: A park straddling Koto and Edogawa wards across the Old Nakagawa River. It serves as a disaster-prevention base and evacuation site in emergencies.

shinjuku-central-park.name: Shinjuku Central Park
shinjuku-central-park.access: about 10 min walk from Shinjuku Station (JR, Odakyu, Keio) / about 5 min walk from Nishi-Shinjuku Station (Marunouchi Line) / 0 min walk from Tochomae Station (Oedo Line)
shinjuku-central-park.summary: A park in Shinjuku City, with an area of 88,363.15 square meters.

kichijoji-parco.name: Kichijoji Parco
kichijoji-parco.access: 2 min walk from Kichijoji Station (JR Chuo/Sobu Line, Keio Inokashira Line)

zoshigaya-kishimojin.name: Zoshigaya Kishimojin
zoshigaya-kishimojin.access: 5 min walk from Exit 1 of Zoshigaya Station (Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line) / about 15 min from the east exit of Ikebukuro Station (JR) / about 15 min from Mejiro Station (JR)
zoshigaya-kishimojin.summary: A hall of Kishimojin, enshrined at a Nichiren-sect temple. It was designated a National Important Cultural Property in Heisei 28 (2016) (per the Toshima City guide).

ikegami-honmonji.name: Ikegami Honmonji Temple
ikegami-honmonji.access: 10 min walk from Ikegami Station (Tokyu Ikegami Line) / 12 min walk from the south exit of Nishi-Magome Station (Toei Asakusa Line) / bus (20 min) from Omori Station (JR Keihin-Tohoku Line) bound for Ikegami Station, get off at Honmonji-mae and walk 5 min
ikegami-honmonji.summary: A head temple of the Nichiren sect located in Ota City, Tokyo.

kibogaoka-park.name: Kibogaoka Park
kibogaoka-park.access: 20 min walk from Chitose-Funabashi Station (Odakyu Line; written "Oda Line" in the official text) / 20 min walk from Hachimanyama Station (Keio Line) / 4 min walk from the Funabashi Kibo Junior High School or Kibogaoka Danchi bus stop (Odakyu Bus / Keio Bus)
kibogaoka-park.summary: A park in Setagaya City. It opened in 1977 (Showa 52) and has a ball-game plaza and a wall-fountain plaza.

koushoji-yagoto.name: Koshoji Temple (Yagoto)
koushoji-yagoto.address: 78 Yagoto-honmachi, Showa Ward, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture
koushoji-yagoto.access: By car: 300 m from the Yagoto intersection on National Route 153 toward Kawana. From the Yotsuya Exit of the Nagoya Expressway, turn right at the "Yotsuya-dori 3" intersection, go straight on Yamate-dori and turn right at the "Yagoto" intersection. Public transport information not confirmed on the official page (TBC)
koushoji-yagoto.summary: A Shingon temple. On the 5th and 13th of each month, stalls line the temple grounds, according to the city and the temple. On the 21st, the Kobo Daishi Zennen day, there is the "Koshoji Marche" (10:00–15:00).

arako-kannon.name: Arako Kannon Temple
arako-kannon.address: Miyamado 138, Arako-cho, Naka Ward, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture
arako-kannon.access: About 500 m southwest of Arako Station on the Aonami Line
arako-kannon.summary: On the grounds of Arako Kannon Temple, the Arako Enku Market is held on the first Sunday of every month (closed in January (1) and February (2); a night market on 8/10, August 10). According to the city, organic vegetables, handmade shops and restaurants line up. According to the city's introduction, the temple is said to have been founded by Priest Taicho in 729 (Tenpyo 1).

nittaiji-kakuozan.name: Nittai-ji Temple (Kakuozan)
nittaiji-kakuozan.address: 〒464-0057 1-1 Hoocho, Chikusa Ward, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture
nittaiji-kakuozan.access: About 15 min. walk from Kakuozan Station on the Higashiyama Subway Line, Exit 1. About 10 min. walk from the "Kakuozan" stop of Nagoya City Bus Kanayama Route 11 (Kanayama–Ikenoshita line) (about 30 min. from JR Kanayama Station)
nittaiji-kakuozan.summary: A Shingon temple. The 21st of each month, the monthly day of Kobo Daishi, is a Zennen day, and according to the Chikusa Ward official page, Zennen stalls are also held along the approach.
nittaiji-kakuozan.rules: On the 21st of each month (Zennen day), the approach becomes a pedestrian zone, so parking is prohibited from the approach to the temple grounds. Visitors coming by car should use the temporary parking (per the temple).

shitennoji.name: Shitennoji Temple
shitennoji.address: 〒543-0051 1-11-18 Shitennoji, Tennoji Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture
shitennoji.access: 12 min. walk north from Tennoji Station (JR Loop Line, Metro Midosuji and Tanimachi Lines). 5 min. walk south from Shitennoji-mae-Yuhigaoka Station
shitennoji.summary: A head temple of the Washu sect. At the Daishikai (the monthly day of Kobo Daishi) on the 21st of each month, stalls line the grounds, according to the official notice.

tsurumi-ryokuchi.name: Hanahaku Memorial Park Tsurumi Ryokuchi
tsurumi-ryokuchi.place: Outdoor annex exhibition space of Hanamizuki Hall (Mizu no Kan Hall)
tsurumi-ryokuchi.summary: An urban park in Tsurumi Ward, Osaka City. According to the official site, Hanamizuki Hall (Mizu no Kan Hall) can be used together with its outdoor annex exhibition space.

nagai-park.name: Nagai Park
nagai-park.address: 〒546-0034 1-1 Nagai Park, Higashisumiyoshi Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture
nagai-park.access: Right outside Exit 2 of Nagai Station on the Metro Midosuji Line
nagai-park.summary: An urban park in Higashisumiyoshi Ward, Osaka City. The official site announces the 4th Nagai Antique Market (Nomi-no-ichi) at the Southwest Plaza (11/21–11/23, 2026).

ikea-tsuruhama.name: IKEA Tsuruhama
ikea-tsuruhama.address: 〒551-0023 2-24-55 Tsurumachi, Taisho Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture
ikea-tsuruhama.access: IKEA shuttle bus (between IKEA Tsuruhama and Ohashi-bashi). Free parking, 2100 spaces (within business hours only)
ikea-tsuruhama.summary: An IKEA store. The store-event section of the official site lists "Loppis (flea market)".
